activation_gate.missed_deadline: DO_NOT_ACTIVATE; do not shift the cutoff or retroactively enroll

authorization: User explicitly activates remaining unexperienced portion of this date only; excludes all earlier activity and all previously named task details.
comparison_rule: Keep parent same-category/duration/delay/evidence gates; currently no same-category pair, so only individual observations/feasibility may result. Do not relax gates or replace cases.
evidence_custody: Original private sources/owner, unopened for study until full recall freeze. No new evidence collection requested. Private context record stored separately from GitHub.
global_eligibility: W2-W4 must genuinely begin at/after earliest_start and before observation_close; exclude any block begun before freeze or earliest_start, a continuation, overlapping block, or uncertain start. No enrollment by slicing prior activity.
overlap_rule: No double scoring; nested candidate excluded, not replaced; simultaneous starts lower ID first.
preexposure_rule: All earlier named task identities and disclosed facts excluded; remembering that a named task was planned/performed is not a scored success. Catch-all covers further earlier disclosures even if absent from private summary.
recall_order: Broad spontaneous recall first; then eligible windows in actual chronological order with parent neutral cue caps; excluded W1 not tested.
routine_baseline: Not prospectively established for these remaining heterogeneous candidates; cannot infer routine from poor recall.
scope_amendment: Prospective remainder of today replaces whole future day; original proposed protocol remains unchanged.
window_end_rule: First natural completion, principal-activity change, break >=10 minutes, 90 minutes from start, or observation close. Do not change ordinary activity to meet these rules.
